_comment: Candidate models NOT yet installed, considered by `reins hardware gaps`. Sizes are approximate download/disk footprint; vram_gb is the approximate working-set requirement (not just weight size). 'backend' notes what execution path a model needs - 'ollama' entries can be pulled and used today; other backends are candidates only until that execution path is built (see knowledge_base/MODEL_GAPS.md notes).

candidates.note: Wiki/RAG search quality is currently pure FTS5 keyword match; a local embedding model is a cheap, high-value gap to fill.
CPU-only text-to-speech, no GPU needed. Zero coverage today - only speech-to-text (Whisper) exists.
Lighter, in-process alternative to the current whisper-CLI-over-SSH-to-tell path used by the digest pipeline; would let audio/video ingestion run on amdy without depending on tell being online.

Smallest realistic fit for 8GB VRAM. No execution backend exists yet - ModelRouter._dispatch has no comfyui branch. Install only once a ComfyUI/diffusers backend is built; tracked as a future-work gap, not actionable today.
Tight fit at 8GB VRAM (leaves ~0.5GB headroom) - only consider after sd-turbo is validated. Same backend gap as sd-turbo.
Not realistically installable on 8GB VRAM with no execution backend today. Recorded as an open gap, not a recommendation - revisit if a higher-VRAM node is added to the cluster.
